title: Keep the tiny-lane exemption on the no-grant arm only
intent: A second independent read of aac9984f found the tiny-lane exemption added in 96db1a33 sits above BOTH arms (hook_local.rs:604), so a feature that ALREADY holds a granted worktree can now take a lane-tiny source edit in the main checkout. The parent commit denied that (96db1a33^:hook_local.rs:531 exempted lane "docs" only). AGENTS.md gives main a solo tiny fix, but a feature whose worktree already exists is precisely the drift this guard exists to stop — a tiny edit landing in main while its worktree is live is a merge conflict waiting at bee worktree merge. The exemption belongs to the new no-grant arm, where it means "this work is small enough not to need a worktree at all".
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/write_guard/hook_local.rs: narrow the lane exemption at :604 back to `lane == "docs"` for the granted-worktree arm, and keep `docs || tiny` on the new no-grant arm only. Restructure minimally — the docs exemption stays where it is; the tiny half moves down beside the no-grant arm's own phase gate (:645-651). Update the comment at :595-603 so it states which arm each exemption serves and why. In tests.rs: the existing case proving lane tiny allows must be split into two — lane tiny with NO grant still allows, lane tiny WITH a granted worktree now denies (the granted arm's existing message).
acceptance: Lane tiny in the main checkout, with a granted worktree for the acting feature, is DENIED with the granted arm's existing message — matching 96db1a33^ behavior.
Lane tiny in the main checkout with NO grant for the acting feature still allows.
Lane docs allows on both arms, unchanged.
Every other test in the write_guard suite passes unchanged.

truths: The granted-worktree arm exempts lane docs only, as it did before this feature.
The no-grant arm exempts lane docs and lane tiny.
Both directions are pinned by their own test.

trace.outcome: Narrowed the tiny-lane worktree-first exemption to the no-grant arm; granted arm now denies lane tiny too
